selection.order: ascending SHA256(seed + LF + source + LF + original question ID), then original ID
selection.exclude: all material IDs and question text/IDs present in supplied previous calibration and raw caches
selection.answerPolicy: Keep original author gold and all annotations verbatim; never filter on answerability, evidence length, conflict, difficulty, retrieval, or algorithm output.
selection.corpusPolicy: Freeze complete eligible QASPER split materials after prior-material exclusion; forum packages are supplementary retrieval gold or future noise, not invented answer gold.
selection.forumQuestionOrder: same seeded hash rule, independent from QASPER selection

prohibited: private Piazza or fabricated mail/Canvas sources
acceptance: This freeze is only a candidate input package. Three actual distinct 100% runs and required data-state transitions remain to be executed separately. Forum qrels measure duplicate-document retrieval and do not certify final answer correctness.
oldMaterialIneligibility: SyllabusQA previous calibration corpus includes all 63 author syllabi; remaining questions cannot count as unseen material.
